title: Dispatcher-level unknown-flag rejection (stderr, message-compatible) + registry gap declarations + red-first regression
action: Per D4 RESCOPED by validation C7/C8/C9 — unknown-flag rejection ONLY; required-flag enforcement stays with handlers (validate-args.mjs:100-107 DB3 comment: required:[] is deliberate on 69/116 entries; handler requireFlag already exits 1). CORRECTED PREMISE (C7): 'bee capture add --text x' already exits 1 via requireFlag(outcome) — the gap is the error never NAMES the unknown flag --text, and the orchestrator-visible symptom (timing line only, stderr swallowed by tail) misread it as silent success. (1) RED FIRST: add test asserting `bee capture add --text x` stderr NAMES '--text' as unknown — run before the fix, record the red (today stderr only complains missing outcome). (2) Central check in the dispatcher AFTER resolveCommand, BEFORE handler dispatch: any parsed flag not in entry.parameters.properties and not in the explicit global allow-list (json, help) -> emitError to STDERR, exit 1, message shape compatible with existing bespoke loops: `<group> <verb>: unknown flag --X (known: ...)` (C8: stderr channel is pinned by test_cli_state.mjs:1116; KEEP both bespoke loops bee.mjs:1236-1239 and :3084-3087, delete nothing — central check simply fires first with the same channel+shape so their assertions still pass; if any pinned assertion regex conflicts, match the assertion, never the other way). Entry with no registry match -> throw unknown command, never silently skip (C9). (3) DECLARE the 7 known registry gaps in command-registry.mjs so the suite stays green (C9 floor): cells.claim --isolate, cells.claim-next --isolate, state.gate --owner, state.start-feature --isolate, config.get/set/unset --local; and FLAG_ALONE_BOOLEANS local+isolate get declared on those entries. Any additional red = another gap: declare it, never loosen the validator. (4) Update the now-false comment validate-args.mjs:90 ('unknown-flag rejection is the dispatcher/hook's own concern' — it now IS the dispatcher's concern; point at the dispatcher check). (5) Fix the friction record honestly: log one decision correcting the earlier friction note (bug was message quality + orchestrator tail habit, not silent exit 0). (6) REGEN OBLIGATION: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs, then node packages/bee/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply, then node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write, then node scripts/impact_registry.mjs --write.

Regen chain run (render_plugin_skill_trees, self-onboard --apply, release_manifest --write, impact_registry --write).
